description: The code an Interaction node writes from its edit log (#662). Jest checks editFeaturesCode writes each `code` from its `settings`; utk_curio/sandbox/tests/test_feature_edits.py runs each `code` against `input` and checks the features left, by `key`.

cases.name: a new node: no edits, so the input is handed on as it came
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [])

cases.name: two buildings removed, by their building_id, from one layer of several
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "remove", "ids": [1, 3]},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings")

cases.name: a value set, a removal, then the removal put back
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "set", "ids": [2], "column": "name", "value": "Tower \"B\""},
    {"op": "remove", "ids": [3]},
    {"op": "restore", "ids": [3]},
    {"op": "set", "ids": [1], "column": "height", "value": None},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings")

cases.name: an Interaction log: a raise, a removal switched off and a removal by condition
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "offset", "ids": [2], "column": "height", "value": 3, "label": "Raise the tower"},
    {"op": "remove", "ids": [1], "label": "First building", "enabled": False},
    {"op": "remove", "where": "building_id >= 3"},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings")

cases.name: a scale where a condition holds, and a value computed by an expression
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "scale", "where": "height > 11", "column": "height", "value": 0.5},
    {"op": "expr", "ids": [3], "column": "height", "value": "10 * 2"},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings")

cases.name: a building drawn on the node's map is added, with its height
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "add", "id": 4, "geometry": {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[9, 0], [10, 0], [10, 1], [9, 1], [9, 0]]]}, "values": {"height": 20}},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings", crs="EPSG:3395")

cases.name: a building redrawn, and a property added to every building
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "geometry", "ids": [2], "geometry": {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[9, 0], [10, 0], [10, 1], [9, 1], [9, 0]]]}},
    {"op": "add_column", "column": "kind", "value": "office"},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings", crs="EPSG:3395")

cases.name: a new layer of points, a point drawn into it, and a building removed
cases.code:
# Edit Features writes this code from its edit list: each edit, in the
# order it was made, on the features whose key is one of its ids. It is
# written again when the list changes.
return curio_edit_features(input_0, [
    {"op": "add", "layer": "cooling_centers", "id": "new-1", "geometry": {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [3, 3]}, "values": {"name": "Library"}},
    {"op": "remove", "ids": [3]},
], key="building_id", layer="table_osm_buildings", new_layers=[{"name": "cooling_centers", "geometry": "Point", "properties": [{"name": "name", "type": "text", "required": True}]}], crs="EPSG:3395")
